title: 纸飞机爷爷与打盹的蚂蚁

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we meet a grandpa who folds paper planes, and tiny ants that sleep in a very strange way. Ready? Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天我们要认识一位爱折纸飞机的爷爷，还有睡觉方式特别奇怪的小蚂蚁。准备好了吗？出发！

blocks.en: John Collins has loved paper planes since he was a boy. He folded hundreds of them — big, small, fast, and funny. He was not an accountant, but he counted every fold and every test flight until his planes flew straight and far. His best design was named Suzanne, after his wife. It used just one sheet of paper, with long, thin wings. But a great plane needs a great throw, so John asked his friend Joe Ayoob, a strong football player, to throw it.
blocks.title: 纸飞机爷爷
blocks.cn: 约翰·柯林斯从小就喜欢纸飞机。他折了几百架——大的、小的、快的、好玩的。他不是会计师，但他数过每一次折叠和每一次试飞，直到他的飞机飞得又直又远。他最好的设计以妻子的名字命名为“苏珊号”。它只用了一张纸，有着长长的薄薄的翅膀。但一架好飞机还需要有力的一投，所以约翰请朋友乔·阿约布——一位强壮的橄榄球运动员——来投它。

blocks.en: One day, inside a huge empty airplane hangar, Joe threw Suzanne with all his strength. The little plane flew and flew — farther than five school buses in a row — and landed 69.14 meters away. The judges measured it carefully and approved the new world record! If a fold is loose, air leaks through the gap and the plane wobbles, so every fold must be neat and tight. And when a test plane crashed, John did not mourn it — he just folded again. That is the bond between a designer and a thrower: one dreams, one throws, and together they fly into the record books.
blocks.title: 纸飞机爷爷
blocks.cn: 有一天，在一个巨大的空飞机机库里，乔用尽全力投出了苏珊号。小飞机飞呀飞——比五辆校车排成一排还远——落在了 69.14 米外。裁判们仔细测量，批准了这项新的世界纪录！如果折痕松了，空气会从缝隙里漏出来，飞机就会摇晃，所以每道折痕都必须整齐、严实。当一架试飞的飞机坠毁时，约翰没有为它哀悼——他只是重新折了一架。这就是设计师和投掷手之间的纽带：一个做梦，一个投掷，他们一起飞进了纪录册。

blocks.en: Meanwhile, down in the grass, ants look like they never sleep. They run here and there, day and night. But scientists filmed a fire ant nest, and they found a secret: ants do sleep — they just sleep in tiny pieces! A worker ant takes about 253 naps every day, and each nap lasts just over a minute. All those little naps accumulate into almost five hours of sleep.
blocks.title: 打盹的蚂蚁
blocks.cn: 与此同时，在草地里，蚂蚁看起来好像从不睡觉。它们跑来跑去，日夜不停。但科学家们拍下了一个火蚁窝，发现了一个秘密：蚂蚁确实睡觉——只是睡成了一小段一小段！一只工蚁每天大约打 253 个盹，每个盹只有一分多钟。所有这些小盹加起来，差不多有五个小时的睡眠。

blocks.en: The statistics are amazing. Because workers nap at different times, about 80 out of every 100 ants are awake and working at any moment, so the nest never stops. The queen sleeps much longer — about nine hours a day in longer naps, with her antennae twitching like she is dreaming. Ants do not have eyelids, so they cannot close their eyes. When a worker finds a crumb of bacon, she calls her sisters to help carry it home. And every morning, she washes her face with her front legs — her own quick facial! So when you see an ant rushing past, remember: she is just between naps.
blocks.title: 打盹的蚂蚁
blocks.cn: 统计数字非常惊人。因为工蚁们在不同时间打盹，所以在任何时刻，大约每 100 只蚂蚁中就有 80 只醒着干活，蚁窝就从不停工。蚁后睡得久得多——每天大约九个小时，分成较长的几次小睡，触角抖动着，像在做梦。蚂蚁没有眼皮，所以闭不上眼睛。当一只工蚁找到一块培根碎屑时，她会叫姐妹们来帮忙搬回家。每天早上，她还用前腿洗脸——她自己的快速面部清洁！所以当你看到一只蚂蚁匆匆跑过时，记住：她只是在两次打盹之间。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: 'rock the boat.' When you rock the boat, you upset a calm situation or cause trouble in a group. Here's an example: 'Our class had a happy plan for the picnic, and nobody wanted to rock the boat, so we all agreed to go to the park.' Rocking a real boat is fun for a second — and wet for everyone! So, when do you think it is good to speak up, even if it rocks the boat a little?
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“rock the boat”（摇晃小船）。当你 rock the boat 时，你会打破平静的局面，或者在团体里惹出麻烦。举个例子：“我们班为野餐定了一个开心的计划，没人想 rock the boat，所以我们都同意去公园。”摇晃一艘真船好玩一秒钟——但每个人都会弄湿！那么，你觉得什么时候就算会稍微 rock the boat 一点，也值得说出来呢？

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories: a record-breaking paper plane, and ants that nap one minute at a time. First: if you folded a paper plane, what would you name it, and who would you ask to throw it? Second: if you could nap like an ant, would you take 253 tiny naps, or one long sleep like the queen? And one last question: can you think of a time when you did not want to rock the boat? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事：一架飞进纪录册的纸飞机，和一次只睡一分钟的蚂蚁。第一：如果你折一架纸飞机，你会给它起什么名字，又会请谁来投它？第二：如果你能像蚂蚁一样打盹，你会选择 253 个小盹，还是像蚁后一样睡一次长觉？还有最后一个问题：你有没有过不想 rock the boat 的时候？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Fold straight, nap smart like an ant — and don't rock the boat! See you tomorrow!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。折得直直的，像蚂蚁一样聪明地打盹——别 rock the boat！明天见！

quiz.title: B. 单项选择（Single Choice）
questions:
What was special about John's best paper plane design?
A. It was made of metal
B. It used just one sheet of paper
C. It had a motor
D. It was as big as a bus

How far did Suzanne fly?
A. 69.14 meters
B. 25 meters
C. 100 meters
D. 12 meters

How do worker ants sleep?
A. One long sleep at night
B. About 253 tiny naps a day
C. They never sleep at all
D. Only in winter

What does "rock the boat" mean?
A. To row a boat fast
B. To build a boat
C. To upset a calm situation or cause trouble
D. To fish from a boat

children.text: every fold must be neat and tight.
：If（如果）+ 条件（折痕松了）→ 后面跟结果（空气漏、飞机晃）。英语里 If 条件句专门表示“如果……就……”的假设。
air leaks through the gap and the plane wobbles
：and 把两个现象连起来——空气漏出来、飞机摇晃，两个结果同时发生，不用拆成两句话。
so every fold must be neat and tight
：so（所以）+ 结论——前面说了松折痕的坏处，所以得出结论：每道折痕都必须整齐、严实。
假设条件（If 折痕松）→ 并列结果（漏气 + 摇晃）→ 得出结论（so 折痕要严实）
。一句话里藏着条件句、并列分句和结果句三个机关。
"It used just one sheet of paper, with long, thin wings."
"A worker ant takes about 253 naps every day, and each nap lasts just over a minute."
"When you rock the boat, you upset a calm situation or cause trouble in a group."
D. Your own translations — there is no key for this part. Read your Chinese aloud and check that it sounds natural.
